TinTower1FEusineSuicuneText:
EUSINE: Awesome!
Too awesome, even!

I've never seen a
battle that great.

That was truly
inspiring to see.

SUICUNE was tough,
but you were even

more incredible,
{PLAYER}.

I heard SUICUNE's
mystic power

summons a rainbow-
colored #MON.

Maybe, just maybe,
what went on today

will cause that
#MON to appear.

I'm going to study
the legends more.

Thanks for showing
me that fantastic battle.

Later, {PLAYER}!
TinTower1FSage1Text:
According to
legend…

When the souls of
#MON and humans

commune, from the
heavens descends a

#MON of rainbow
colors…

Could it mean the
legendary #MON

are testing us
humans?
TinTower1FSage2Text:
When the BRASS
TOWER burned down,

three nameless
#MON were said

to have perished.
It was tragic.

However…

A rainbow-colored
#MON…

In other words…

HO-OH descended
from the sky and

gave new life to
the three #MON.

They are…

SUICUNE, ENTEI and
RAIKOU.

That is what they
say.
TinTower1FSage3Text:
The two TOWERS are
said to have been

built to foster
friendship and

hope between #-
MON and people.

That was 700 years
ago, but the ideal

still remains
important today.
TinTower1FSage4Text1:
HO-OH appears to
have descended

upon this, the TIN
TOWER!
TinTower1FSage5Text1:
This will protect
you. Take it.
TinTower1FSage6Text1:
I believe you are
being tested.

Free your mind
from uncertainty, and advance.
TinTower1FEusineHoOhText:
I knew it.

I knew you'd get
to see the #MON

of rainbow colors,
{PLAYER}.

It happened just
as I envisioned.

My research isn't
bad, I might say.

I'm going to keep
studying #MON

to become a famous
#MANIAC!
TinTower1FSage4Text2:
The legendary
#MON are said

to embody three
powers…

The lightning that
struck the TOWER.

The fire that
burned the TOWER.

And the rain that
put out the fire…
TinTower1FSage5Text3:
When the legendary
#MON appeared…

They struck terror
in those who saw their rise.

And…

Some even took to
futile attacks.

The legendary
#MON, knowing

their own power,
fled, ignoring the frightened people.
TinTower1FSage6Text2:
Of the legendary
#MON, SUICUNE

is said to be the
closest to HO-OH.

I hear there may
also be a link to

#MON known as
UNOWN.

The #MON UNOWN
must be sharing a

cooperative bond
with SUICUNE.
